title: Cohomology bounds descend from finite local models
statement:
Let $S$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let $\Gamma$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], put $R=\Gamma(*)$ and $\Gamma_T=p_T^*\Gamma$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] for schemes $T$. Let $Q\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(\Gamma_S))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose $\{V_i\to S\}_{i=1}^n$ is a finite covering family of $S_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [sk-def-pe-site]. Fix integers $r\le s$ and scalar cochain complexes $Q_i^\bullet$ with $Q_i^q=0$ for $q\notin[r,s]$. Assume $Q|_{V_i}\simeq\Gamma_{V_i}\otimes_R Q_i^\bullet$ in the derived category, where scalar modules mean constant sheaves as in [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Assume each functor $M\mapsto\Gamma_{V_i}\otimes_R M$ on $R$-modules is exact and every $H^q(Q_i^\bullet)$ is finitely presented over $R$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Then $H^q(Q)=0$ for $q\notin[r,s]$, and
$$H^q(Q)|_{V_i}\simeq\Gamma_{V_i}\otimes_R H^q(Q_i^\bullet).$$
In particular each $H^q(Q)$ has a finite constant local model [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model] and is constructible on the single stratum $S$, so $Q\in\Dbc(S,\Gamma)$ [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude].

proof.text: Apply derived cohomology to each given model isomorphism, then homologyFunctorFactors and the exact-functor complex comparison mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso for finiteConstantScalarExtension. Compose these isomorphisms with Step 1. The result uses exactly the original covering members and complexes.

Outside [r,s], the middle object of (K_i.sc q) is zero. ShortComplex.isZero_homology_of_isZero_X₂ makes scalar homology zero. Additive scalar extension preserves zero, and the isomorphism of Step 2 makes every restricted H^q(Q) zero.

source.place: Zero middle term gives zero kernel/image homology.

proof.text: Extension of scalars along the invertible condensedPullbackHom is naturally restriction along its inverse, so forgetting the restricted module gives ordinary abelian-sheaf inverse image. For weakly etale cover members, upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction identifies this with slice restriction. Apply the proved source-library isIso_of_isIso_localizationRestriction to the zero endomorphism of H^q(Q).X: its restrictions are maps between zero objects, hence invertible. An invertible zero endomorphism makes the identity zero and yields IsZero of the underlying sheaf; faithfulness of Mod.forget gives IsZero of H^q(Q). The covering-sieve criterion includes the empty cover.

proof.text: Use finiteConstantLocalModel_iff_exists_cover with the original cover, the original scalar homology and the given finite-presentation witnesses. The trivial one-piece stratification realizes constructibility when the scheme is qcqs; pullback_finiteConstantLocalModel along the identity supplies its local models. Otherwise pull these models to each affine open using the proved pullback_finiteConstantLocalModel and use its trivial stratification. Finally isGE_iff and isLE_iff turn the vanishing interval into canonical t-structure boundedness; combine it with constructibility in the definition of constantModelBoundedConstructible.
